decision.rationale: Setup complete: every case's jars, worktrees and JDKs digest-checked; Batik 1_17 source mirrored by commit; registered observations re-run on fresh JVMs equal their receipts (Commons IO, ThreeTenBP, POI, Spring 480) and the named startup incidents reproduce (charset, lookup-name ExceptionInInitializerError, cleared line.separator, Batik duplicate resources). Captures and proofs are the domain's. No job pending.
